title: PhysMoE: Fast Spatial Grounding with Single-Token Coordinate Representation in Modality-Decoupled VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.13000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are backbones for robotic planning and manipulation. However, for coordinate prediction in grounding tasks, existing architectures suffer from two distinct bottlenecks: discrete tokenization disrupts spatial continuity with high decoding latency, while standard point regression fails on multi-contact affordances and irregularly shaped targets. To resolve these challenges, we propose PhysMoE, introducing three core contributions: (1) sharing lower layers for multimodal context while routing upper layers to specialized spatial (pixel) and linguistic (text) experts by physical modality, eliminating gradient interference; (2) encoding each coordinate as a single token by reusing the visual encoder's learned positional embeddings, injecting 2D spatial priors to natively align coordinates with visual features and ease training; and (3) differentiable Signed Distance Field (SDF) supervision on pointing,

translated_title: PhysMoE：基于模态解耦VLM中单Token坐标表示的快速空间定位
translated_abstract: 具身视觉语言模型（VLM）是机器人规划与操作的骨干网络。然而，在定位任务的坐标预测方面，现有架构存在两个明显的瓶颈：离散Token化破坏了空间连续性且解码延迟高，而标准点回归方法在多接触可供性和不规则形状目标上表现不佳。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了PhysMoE，其包含三项核心贡献：（1）共享下层网络用于多模态上下文处理，同时将上层网络按物理模态路由到专用的空间（像素）专家和语言（文本）专家，从而消除梯度干扰；（2）通过复用视觉编码器学习到的位置嵌入，将每个坐标编码为单个Token，注入2D空间先验，使坐标与视觉特征天然对齐并简化训练；（3）对指向任务采用可微的有符号距离场（SDF）监督。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PhysMoE框架，通过物理模态解耦的专家路由、复用视觉位置嵌入的单Token坐标表示以及可微SDF监督，实现了具身VLM中快速且精确的空间定位。
en_tdlr: PhysMoE enables fast and accurate spatial grounding in embodied VLMs through physically modality-decoupled expert routing, single-token coordinate representation reusing visual positional embeddings, and differentiable SDF supervision.
